text: Every successful `query_database` result's `_meta` includes a `sqllens/model_info` channel, independent of the resolved profile's `show_details` setting and of any other flag.
The `sqllens/model_info` channel carries exactly these two fields — `model` and `reasoning_effort` — and no others.
The `model` field holds the configured Anthropic model id, which is the value of `cfg.llm.model` for the running server.

The `reasoning_effort` field holds the configured reasoning effort, which is the value of `cfg.llm.effort` for the running server: one of the `EffortLevel` values defined in `src/sqllens/config.py` when an effort is configured, and JSON `null` — present, not omitted — when no effort is configured.
A trace-carrying `isError` result from `query_database` does not include a `sqllens/model_info` channel.
